gloss: to count on; to rely on; to expect

definitions.gloss: to count on; to rely on; to depend on; to expect something from someone or something
definitions.explanation: To place one's expectations or reliance on someone or something. Often used in the negative or with a warning nuance, suggesting that relying on it may lead to disappointment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{当|あ}てにしない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You'd better not count on him.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{当|あ}てにして⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}した→計画する：20998_keikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I planned a trip counting on my bonus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当|あ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Weather forecasts can sometimes be unreliable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{当|あ}てにして⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't become independent if you keep relying on your parents' support.

notes:
{当|あ}て means "aim" or "expectation," and {当|あ}てにする means to make something one's expectation or reliance. The negative form {当|あ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ (unreliable) is extremely common and is one of the most natural ways to say something is unreliable in Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{当|あ}てにする: to count on ~
- {当|あ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: unreliable; can't be counted on
- {当|あ}てにしない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧: you'd better not count on it
- {当|あ}てにして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧: was counting on it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頼|たよ}りにする→頼りにする：22186_tayorinisuru⟧: to rely on; to depend on — warmer nuance; implies trust and emotional dependence
- ⟦{期待|きたい}する→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧: to expect; to look forward to — more neutral; focuses on anticipation
- ⟦{信用|しんよう}する→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧: to trust — focuses on believing someone is trustworthy
